question: Should OpenClaw adopt an immutable, persisted per-child-session `sessions_spawn.tools` permission policy as the supported security boundary, including its CLI and ACP limitations?
rationale: This is a new user-facing capability and persisted session contract with security consequences; the supplied context indicates API-shape direction but does not provide enough verified repository evidence to establish final maintainer approval.

options.title: Sponsor the session policy
